summary.disposition_text: The decline-bias is EARNED SIGNAL, and the FAIR DEF-6 well does NOT change it. DEF-1 is the make-or-break: zeroing the four secular terms sends chi2/dof 3.68 -> 8.39 (2.3x worse), and set free the fit pins every secular term DOWN (secC +0.010, secPb +0.012); even a recovery-weighted refit rails down. DEF-2/DEF-3 are INERT-ON-HINDCAST (deltas 0.00068, 0.00483; inexercisable, not disproven); DEF-4 subsumed (rate shift 1.7%, both refits rail decl->0). The FAIR DEF-6 well - curvature-matched, cleanly anchored, calibration re-solving cleanly at 3.0e-06 (NOT the malformed 40x break) - is NON-selective: inert on the five regions already above the tip (Israel STRUCTURALLY - pb0 3.15 exceeds the two-child plateau 2.0, no admissible tip reaches it; Germany INSTANCE-level at the carried un-swept tip_P=1.72 - the computed horns in H468 close the repair) and moving only ['Italy', 'Korea', 'Poland'], so recovery RMSE 0.144 does not beat baseline 0.124 while chi2/dof 3.80. No config reaches the both-improve corner, so no emergent.py graft is warranted; the honest shipped default remains the monotone-decline baseline (E50 precedent). The REMOVE is now earned on the correct form.

make_or_break.note: DEF-1 is the only defect the backtest directly adjudicates; it settles the omnibus defect-vs-feature question (POOLED-OBJECTIVE-CONDITIONAL, and the recovery-weighted refit also rails down)
